compose_config:
name: edgecitadel-e2e-run-ms3mz7zp-1be7664a2e7a
services:
  backend:
    build:
      context: $SOURCE_ROOT
      dockerfile: aggregator/Dockerfile
    depends_on:
      nats:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      DB_PATH: /data/openclaw.db
      NATS_TOKEN: <generated-per-run-token>
      NATS_URL: nats://nats:4222
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - python
        - -c
        - import urllib.request,sys; r=urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8000/api/system/status', timeout=2); sys.exit(0 if r.status==200 else 1)
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 3s
      retries: 15
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 8000
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: test-data
        target: /data
        volume: {}
  fixture-agent:
    build:
      context: $SOURCE_ROOT
      dockerfile: scripts/research/Dockerfile
    command:
      - python3
      - -m
      - scripts.research.fixtures.native_control
      - --config
      - /run/config/native-control.json
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      EC_CREDENTIAL_FILE: /run/secrets/transport-token
      EC_TERMINAL_RELEASE_DIR: /run/control
      NATS_URL: nats://nats:4222
    networks:
      default: null
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: <fixture-config>
        target: /run/config/native-control.json
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
      - type: bind
        source: <credential-file>
        target: /run/secrets/transport-token
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
      - type: bind
        source: <control-dir>
        target: /run/control
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
      - type: volume
        source: fixture-state
        target: /run/state
        volume: {}
  frontend:
    build:
      context: $SOURCE_ROOT/frontend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - -q
        - -O
        - /dev/null
        - http://127.0.0.1:80
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 3s
      retries: 15
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 80
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: $SOURCE_ROOT/e2e/test-nginx.conf
        target: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
  nats:
    command:
      - -c
      - /etc/nats/nats.conf
    environment:
      NATS_TOKEN: <generated-per-run-token>
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - --spider
        - -q
        - http://localhost:8222/healthz
      timeout: 3s
      interval: 3s
      retries: 10
    image: nats@sha256:b83efabe3e7def1e0a4a31ec6e078999bb17c80363f881df35edc70fcb6bb927
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 4222
        protocol: tcp
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 8222
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: $SOURCE_ROOT/e2e/test-nats.conf
        target: /etc/nats/nats.conf
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
      - type: volume
        source: nats_test_data
        target: /data
        volume: {}
networks:
  default:
    name: edgecitadel-e2e-run-ms3mz7zp-1be7664a2e7a_default
volumes:
  fixture-state:
    name: edgecitadel-e2e-run-ms3mz7zp-1be7664a2e7a_fixture-state
  nats_test_data:
    name: edgecitadel-e2e-run-ms3mz7zp-1be7664a2e7a_nats_test_data
  test-data:
    name: edgecitadel-e2e-run-ms3mz7zp-1be7664a2e7a_test-data
